candidates.title: City station readings (hourly) - NO2 and PM2.5 from city stations
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of hourly NO2 and PM2.5 by station_id; could cover the production window if the 2024-2025 export is complete. Timestamps are UTC (ts_utc).
candidates.found_via: search 'city air quality station hourly NO2 PM2.5 readings'; get_catalog_entry; wiki backlink station_network
suspected_issues: Catalog temporal_coverage starts 2023-01-01, so it does not cover the prototype window (2004-2005) (catalog airq.station_readings)
Station VR-03 (Via Roma) switched off 2024-06-30 per wiki station_network, but catalog still lists the network as active
No station coordinates in catalog columns, so matching to weather coordinates cannot be checked from metadata
No documented handling of sensor-fault zeros or negatives

candidates.title: Road traffic counts (hourly) - counters near monitoring stations
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal hourly vehicle count source; counters are described as near monitoring stations. Covers 2024-2025 if coverage holds.
candidates.found_via: search 'city air quality station hourly NO2 PM2.5 readings' and 'ARPA station export hourly pollutants'; get_catalog_entry; wiki backlink counter_replacement_2024
suspected_issues: Counters replaced 2024-03-18; counts changed from per-direction to both directions combined (wiki counter_replacement_2024); catalog has no note about this
Timestamp is ts_local (local time), not UTC, so alignment with UTC station data is needed
Catalog columns carry counter_id only; no station or distance link is documented
Unit is vehicles per hour, but vehicle class definition is not documented

candidates.title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district)
candidates.why_relevant: Daily respiratory visit counts by district with no patient identifiers, which is the permitted form under the clinic data policy.
candidates.found_via: search 'respiratory clinic visits daily count by district'; get_catalog_entry; wiki backlink clinic_data_policy
suspected_issues: Catalog temporal_coverage starts 2022-01-01; covers 2024-2025 only if daily rows are complete
Respiratory definition (diagnosis codes or visit types) not documented in catalog
District boundary set and stability not documented; district is 'District of residence'
Small-cell suppression rule and written consent or data-sharing basis not documented in catalog or wiki

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Only register source for hourly temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m covering both windows. Approved for prototyping and production under the register.
suspected_issues: Register default coordinates are Lisbon (38.72, -9.14); client city not named in any source, so coordinates must be set as a recorded assumption in decisions.md
Reanalysis grid, not station observations; differences from station data, especially humidity, must be documented before modelling
Register terms say production use still needs Legal sign-off under open-data policy; licence read at terms_url not yet verified
Register default query uses timezone UTC; must align with station ts_utc and traffic ts_local

rejected_without_profiling.reason: Agreement AD-2021-114 expired 2025-12-31, no signed renewal on file; API key revoked 2026-01-01. Not to be used for N3 (register: vendor.atmosdata_pro).
Restricted, contains PII (patient key, age band, postcode). Clinic data policy forbids use for this analysis; out of scope for N5.
Register lists it for UC1, but none of N1-N6 requires holiday data. Not profiled.
A licensing policy for analyst-supplied dataset links, not a dataset. It does not supply PM2.5 mortality data for N6.

unmet_needs: N1 prototype (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04): no internal source, and the city catalog starts 2023. Needs a public ARPA/ISPRA hourly station series supplied as a link. PM2.5 may not exist for that period (PM10 or NO2 only).
N2 production: only internal traffic.hourly_counts exists. It has no station linkage and a 2024-03-18 counter change. The counter-to-station mapping must be confirmed before it is viable.

N3 production: no station-grade internal weather source. AtmosData Pro is expired and revoked, so only Open-Meteo reanalysis remains. The client city's coordinates are not in any source and must be set as an assumption.
N6: no internal dataset and no register dataset for PM2.5-attributable deaths. A national statistics or ISS/EEA link must be supplied.
N5: excluded by clinic data policy. Not a candidate.
